cases.name: different-route Map entry starts summary before transition and navigation is already active while request is pending
non-Map navigation does not start summary
deferred Map-entry summary settles after navigation and updates current Map state
Map-entry summary rejection does not block or roll back navigation
leave/return while first entry is pending keeps existing generation fencing without canceling navigation
obsolete-profile entry reply is ignored and new profile bootstrap remains authoritative
unavailable native bridge fences summary transport but does not fence local navigation
direct initial Map route does not synthesize a navigation-entry request
profile bootstrap, Map-entry request and independent connected polling remain separately attributable

limits: Actual current App source is parsed and executed with its production callbacks/effects. Page/icon children and bridge/map transport are controlled inert bindings; no network, native provider, Last War, server jump, scan start, update, or gameplay action is invoked. The harness uses disconnected mode except the explicit polling-attribution case, so bootstrap, entry and poll requests can be distinguished.
